note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as reported by Exophase and cross-checked against OutputLag. Guides are written in the author's own words; sources are cited per trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is no separate task to chase. Work through the story first, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, then clear the open-world lists and the long grinds last. Expect around 200 hours in total, all of it single-player, with no online or difficulty roadblock except the Chapter 1 meditation.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the 100% checklist under Progress, then Stats, once the story is done; work you finished earlier still counts toward it. It tracks story progress, stunts, challenges, collectibles, stranger strands and more, so treat it as your endgame to-do list rather than a separate grind. The checklist only appears after the credits, so finish the story before worrying about the exact totals it asks for.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all feed this counter, so mix them up instead of repeating one jump. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 rather than stopping at the pop. Fast planes and bikes make the air stunts far easier, and failed attempts still teach you the line for the next try.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges, and every one needs a gold medal. Learn each range's target pattern first with a slow run, then push for speed once you know where targets appear. Bring your best aim settings and a steady trigger finger; a silver on one challenge just means one more focused attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open through an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4, where you tail an armored van to a large bank and slip in while the guard has the vault open. Bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the bags alone, and expect a four-star wanted level the moment you leave. Escape the red heat zone completely before you count a vault as done.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Stranger strands appear as question marks and side characters across Leonida; only some questlines count, and the ones with their own trophies do not. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish so you know which ones moved it. Start strands as soon as they appear and finish them before the finale, since the finales stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida in packs, and completing any three full sets pops the trophy. Pick up every pack you pass while doing other activities instead of hunting them all at once, then sweep the remaining spots with a map checklist once the story is done. Sets are the long tail of this trophy, so expect a dedicated cleanup pass at the end.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app on your phone and snap the marked spots as you travel; 100 different locations count. It pairs naturally with exploration, so photograph spots whenever you are in a new district instead of saving them for one trip. The counter tracks unique locations only, so revisiting a spot you already snapped adds nothing.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are nine activity types across Leonida, from races and ranges to fishing, arcades and gyms. Sample each one as soon as it unlocks rather than leaving them all for the endgame, since most take only a few minutes to try. If the trophy has not popped, check which activity type you have never touched and head straight for it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different race events count, so vary the event and the location instead of replaying your favourite. Street races, off-road events and drone races each add to the total when they are new to you. Faster cars and a clean racing line matter more than aggression; winning by a car length still counts the same as winning by a mile.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in, then build a four-star wanted level — a bank vault escape is the natural moment, since it hands you four stars at once. Break line of sight, leave the flashing search area, then keep moving until you are fully clear of the red heat zone. The trophy pops only once the heat is gone, not while you are still hiding inside it.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you; if the stars fade to just the red heat zone, the chain breaks. Pick three shops close together on a quiet street and move fast between them. The pop can take about thirty seconds after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of stopping to look at every car. Parked cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all add to the total. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the map until the fog of unexplored territory is gone. Work district by district — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps and the northern towns — so you do not miss a pocket in the far corner. Exploring pairs well with stunt hunting and card collecting, so combine the sweeps rather than doing three separate tours.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations across Leonida, and you need one robbery from each gang's turf. Scout the operation first, hit it fast, then escape before reinforcements arrive. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops naturally on the way to full completion if you vary the gangs you target.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder the cash, and the $250,000 total is cumulative across the whole game. Keep doing vault and loan jobs after the story and launder every batch you earn. There is no need to save bills up — launder them as they come in and the counter climbs steadily.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations, and you need a win at each one. Learn each course's turns on a practice run, then race for the win once you know where the gates sit. Drone handling rewards smooth, early turns more than top speed, so brake before the gate rather than into it.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: The $100,000 is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, car mods and more — so normal spending across a full playthrough gets you most of the way there. Late in the game, top the counter off with big purchases like car upgrades or a wardrobe refresh. Keep receipts in mind only loosely; the total climbs on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages from the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count. Buy them as your cash allows, and remember each one also gives you space to store cars for the Scooter Bros registrations.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap, common cars.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal at a fishing spot and accept his challenge, then out-fish him within the time limit. Watch the line tension and reel in steady bursts instead of holding the button down. If you lose, you can challenge him again, so treat the first attempt as practice for reading the water.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Any of the four in-game arcade games counts, so pick the one you enjoy most and play it through to the end. Arcades are found in bars and entertainment spots around Vice City. A single completed game pops the trophy, so there is no need to chase high scores unless you want them.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, with 18 across Leonida. Bring your partner every time, since an outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1: after she is home, follow her to the balcony in the morning and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends and there is no mission replay, so keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim you trigger by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle to drop five before the focus meter runs out. Adrenaline extends your focus time, so use it when you have a clear line on a clustered group.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Tail an armored truck until it stops, then hit it hard and grab the cash before the guards recover. The robbery itself is quick; the escape is the real test, so plan a fast car and a route away from police. Like the vault jobs, the trophy pops only once you have fully escaped the heat, not while you are still in the search area.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and 50 of the 80 count for this trophy. Many complete on their own while you play — driving, shooting, exploring and side activities all feed different challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so keep pushing past 50 and check the list regularly to see which categories are lagging behind.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first story trophy you will earn and it cannot be missed. Follow the opening beats, learn the basic controls as the mission teaches them, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. If you are just starting, this is your confirmation that the story trophies are tracking.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops as the chapter closes — chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude and make a manual save. Nothing else in Chapter 1 is missable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 opens up the map and the partner system: after Breakfast Run you can switch between Jason and Lucia and call the other in as your partner. Finish the chapter's missions in any order the game offers and the trophy pops at its close. Use Chapter 2 to unlock the garages, the Scooter Bros app and the activities that feed the open-world trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 brings the robbery tools — the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs and the street racing strand — so use the chapter to start the robbery trophies. One race in Yago's strand is time-sensitive, so save first when the hourglass icon appears and race the moment it shows up. Finish the chapter's missions and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is where the big jobs land, including the optional vault mission near its end. Tail the armored van, bring your partner for the bags, and expect four stars on the way out. Complete the chapter's missions and the trophy pops. After Chapter 4, the finale is close, so make a manual save before the final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold trophy is yours. Before you start it, make a manual save — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so this is your last clean checkpoint. After the credits, everything outside the story stays open, including side-story finales and the 100% checklist, so the finale is a doorway, not a dead end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is an early Chapter 2 mission, and finishing it unlocks character switching between Jason and Lucia. That switch is what opens the partner trophies, so complete this mission as soon as it appears and start practising with a partner at your side. It is unmissable — just play the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission — play through it as the story directs and the trophy pops on completion. Stock up on ammo and armour before the big set piece, and use cover during the heavy firefights. Like all story mission trophies, it is unmissable as long as you finish the game.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission that pops its trophy on completion. There is nothing special to prepare: follow the mission markers, complete the objectives, and the trophy is yours when the mission ends. Story mission trophies are all unmissable, so this one is simply a matter of playing through.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission, and its trophy pops when the mission is complete. Expect a loud, set-piece sequence — keep your health topped up and use the mission's checkpoints if a section goes wrong. As with every story trophy, you cannot miss it by playing the story to the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission set at Vice City International Airport, and its trophy pops on completion. The airport setting also matters for Catch Me If You Can, so while you are there, note the docked airliners at the boarding bridges for later. Play the mission through and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission, and its trophy pops when you complete it. It is one of the later story missions, so arrive with full armour and your best weapons. The trophy is unmissable — finishing the mission is all it asks — so focus on surviving the set piece.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends with a final mission that pops this trophy on completion. Side-story finales stay open after the main story, so you can finish Kenton's strand during the endgame cleanup if you prefer. Check the strand's progress after each mission so you know when the finale is available.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand has its own finale mission, and completing it pops this trophy. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers and Freaks, since it has its own trophy, so treat it as a separate questline. Finales stay open after the story, so finish it whenever you are ready.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand ends with a finale mission that pops this trophy when you complete it. Like Billy's and Tyrone's strands, Andy's does not count toward Strangers and Freaks, so track it on its own. The finale stays available after the story ends, so there is no rush to finish it early.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand ends with a finale that pops this trophy on completion. Finales stay open after the credits, so fold Randy's strand into your endgame cleanup. If the strand seems quiet, look for Randy's marker on the map — strands often wait for you to come to them rather than calling you.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand ends with a finale mission, and completing it pops this trophy. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers and Freaks, so follow it as its own questline. Side-story finales stay open after the story, so you can finish this one during the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt rewards. Track the target, take the shot carefully, and the trophy pops when you bring down the unique animal Bret wants.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Board it, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about a kilometre away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a hint: get into a military Rhino tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy police response once you start rolling.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt and Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This trophy is about Jason and Lucia training together: both need to reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Keep at the weights over several sessions and the trophy should pop when both characters hit the top of the Strength stat.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This one tracks 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — robberies, fights and other heat-raising deeds all feed it. You do not need a separate grind: play aggressively through the story and the side content and the counter fills up on its own. Check your profile from time to time to see how close you are.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view over the water and order a cocktail. The trophy is about the moment, not a mission, so pick a scenic spot, sit down and enjoy the drink. It is a small, relaxed trophy — a good palate cleanser between the bigger grinds.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through the glass front of a vehicle showroom and out the other side, in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up, build speed on the street outside, and aim for the glass. The trophy pops on the smash itself, so one good run is all it takes.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The community has not pinned this one down yet: the name suggests it pops when you succeed on a second attempt at something you failed first. Play naturally, retry anything that goes wrong, and it should come without a dedicated grind. Treat any specific method you read online as unconfirmed until more players report it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Another trophy whose method the community is still confirming — the description suggests a strange, unexpected encounter somewhere in Leonida. Explore off the beaten path, check odd landmarks and keep an eye on community reports as players map the weird corners of the state. Do not chase a specific method until one is verified by multiple players.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Perform a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon — and knock down a target like a bowling pin. Line up a slow pass past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops on the hit. A quiet street and a slow car make the timing far easier than a high-speed pass.
